description: This file defines a factory function to generate RESTful CRUD controllers for Mongoose models with tenant scoping enforcement, query optimization, and request validation.

methods.name: validateSort(sort, allowed = ['timestamp', 'created_at', '_id'])
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes a sort string against an allowed list to prevent heavy or unindexed sorts.

methods.name: clampLimit(limit, max = 500)
methods.description: Enforces a maximum page size limit for safety.

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached list response if not expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Stores a list response in cache with a TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Constructs a cache key based on request parameters for list endpoints.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant(req)
methods.description: Sanitizes incoming payloads for create/update operations by stripping client-supplied tenant identifiers and injecting from request context.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant(filter, tenantId)
methods.description: Merges a filter object with tenant enforcement via tenantId, ignoring client-supplied tenant keys.
